question: Could you list each musical style with the number of times it appears as a 1st, 2nd, or 3rd preference in a single row per style?
sql:
SELECT ms.StyleID, ms.StyleName, COUNT(mp.StyleID) AS pref_count
FROM Musical_Styles ms
LEFT JOIN Musical_Preferences mp ON ms.StyleID = mp.StyleID AND mp.PreferenceSeq IN (1, 2, 3)
GROUP BY ms.StyleID, ms.StyleName
ORDER BY ms.StyleID
